title: validation: a script rule's violation is reported on "_record" with no way to name the field it is about
body:
**Filing gate ② — a product decision only the maintainer can make.**

**Who acts on it:** objectstack triage (spec / data validation owner). ⛔ Not a claim. Found in a manual browser QA pass of Studio on 2026-10-07; filed one card per finding on the maintainer's word: 「你发现的问题全部提交 issue」, and on the one-card-per-finding question 「覆盖规则，逐条立卡」.

## Maintainer quick-read

A script validation rule's violation is reported on `_record`, so a form cannot highlight the field it is about. Let rules name a target field?

## Measured

Rule `record.status == 'done' && record.due_date == null` → `POST /api/v1/data/repairs_repair_ticket` `{name, status:'done'}` → 400 `{"code":"VALIDATION_FAILED","fields":[{"field":"_record","code":"rule_violation",…}]}`.

## Options

- **A** — optional `errorField` on script / cross-field rules, reported in `fields[].field`.
- **B** — infer the field from the expression when exactly one field is tested for null.
- **C** — status quo.

## Environment

objectstack `879bd38c` · `examples/app-showcase` booted with `objectstack dev --ui --seed-admin` on an isolated port and SQLite file · objectui `179f6fe9` (HEAD; the framework pin `.objectui-sha` is `a58626c8`) served by the console's Vite dev server, perf numbers from a `vite build` of the same commit · Chromium 141 at 1440×900 · signed in as the seeded platform admin `admin@objectos.ai` unless stated.

## Duplicate check

- Semantic issue search on objectstack-ai/objectstack (open and closed), *validation rule violation _record field target error field*: 3 hits (0 open, 3 closed).
- Semantic issue search on objectstack-ai/objectstack (open and closed), *script validation rule error attached to record instead of the field it checks*: 4 hits (0 open, 4 closed).
- Semantic issue search on objectstack-ai/objectui (open and closed), *form shows validation error for _record not attached to any field*: 3 hits (0 open, 3 closed).
- Related, not the same defect:
  - objectstack-ai/objectstack#4649 (closed) — script-rule behaviour; different defect
- Positive control in the same run: *related lists action id refusal notice shown to end users* on objectstack-ai/objectui returned objectstack-ai/objectui#11768: yes.

Dedupe words: validation rule violation _record field · error field target script rule
